name: entraiot-connect
description: Entraiot Connect — all 3 stages on one server

scripts.build:stage3: cd stage3 && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:management: cd "management workspace" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:marketing: cd "marketing workspace" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:technical: cd "technical workspace" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:financial: cd "financial workspace" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:clienthandling: cd "client handling workspace" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:ceo: cd "entraiot-ceo-main/entraiot-ceo-main" && npm install && npm run build
